messages:
lina-sales: Quick check-in — FinBank wants a concise FAQ for their air-gapped proof-of-concept: upgrade cadence, rollback options, SBOM/license deliverables, and a cost estimate for support. Need a short bullet list we can send.
ark-engineer: Short version: we ship delta bundles ~6 weeks; for air-gapped we can do monthly or per-request. Bundles are GPG-signed, include sha256 checksums and an SPDX SBOM.
tara-security: Recommend we propose a maintained schedule: monthly security hotfixes + quarterly feature bundles. Customer must approve maintenance windows in writing.
lina-sales: They insist on no outbound network during installs. Confirm offline installer behavior.
ark-engineer: Offline bundle is fully self-contained (binaries, models, install script). Installer does not call home. We provide verification steps: verify GPG signature and checksum.
sam-fieldeng: Rollback ask: they want an easy rollback path if upgrade fails.
ark-engineer: Provide `./redwoodctl rollback --to <bundle-id>` which reverts binaries and model artifacts. Important caveat: schema/DB migrations might be irreversible — advise snapshot beforehand.
deploy-bot: Signed bundle 1951122334-rls created. GPG key ABCD1234. sha256: 9a7b... :white_check_mark:
tara-security: They'll need third-party license info (libssl, glibc, python deps). We'll include license matrix and SBOM.
finance-rep: Ballpark fees: offline packaging/signing = $4,000 one-time; remote weekend upgrade support = $12,000 flat; optional onsite engineer = $6,000/day + travel.
lina-sales: Can we commit to an upgrade SLA for the POC?
sam-fieldeng: We can supply a validated runbook, pre-upgrade checklist, and do a canary on non-prod. A firm SLA for success requires Dedicated capacity + PS engagement. Otherwise we state "best-effort with rollback and remediation steps." 
tara-security: They also asked about FIPS builds and KMS/HSM for key storage.
ark-engineer: FIPS-enabled builds exist but are separate artifacts and add ~2 weeks to delivery. KMS/HSM integration requires config work and 2-3 week validation with customer HSM.
lina-sales: Action items I'll send to FinBank: 1) SPDX SBOM + license matrix (ark) 2) signed bundle proof + verification steps (ark) 3) upgrade playbook + rollback checklist (sam) 4) formal quote with weekend/onsite options (finance) 5) FIPS/HSM timeline note (ark + tara).
ark-engineer: I'll attach a tiny sample SBOM and a redwoodctl install/rollback snippet for them.
sam-fieldeng: I'll draft a short upgrade runbook: pre-checks (snapshots, metrics), canary rollout steps, post-validation tests.
finance-rep: I'll prepare a PDF quote and include optional add-ons. Lina, tell me the requested POC dates and whether they'll want onsite.
lina-sales: Great — I'll reply to FinBank with this bundle and ask for preferred maintenance windows. cc @tara-security for sign-off. :thumbsup:
